name: Creekside Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 38.8201,-78.5637: the campground lies in the wooded strip along Stony Creek south of town, sites under canopy within ~30 m of the bank; the operator sells a distinct 'Creekside' site class (sites 15-26) at a premium, which is the confirmation canopy can't give

name: Creeper Trail Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 36.5918,-81.6203: sites on the cleared hillside around the office; Whitetop Laurel Creek runs ~40 m east beyond the road and trail - not waterfront

name: Deer Run Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 36.8318,-80.1985: office at the road with sites in the woods behind it; no water near the sites - not waterfront

name: Devils Fork Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 240 m frame) at 36.8222,-82.6184: a homestead and barn in a grassy clearing above the creek, no pads visible (imagery may predate the sites); the creek is 60 m east past the road - not waterfront

name: Eggleston Springs Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame, leaf-off) at 37.2906,-80.6142: a row of trailers lines the New River bank on the inside of the bend, 5-15 m from the water on open ground; pin moved ~130 m W onto that row

name: Fort Valley Ranch & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 38.7539,-78.5124: the Google pin is the riding arena; the campsite loops are in the woods to the SW around two small ponds, not beside them - not waterfront (pin moved ~200 m SW into the loops)

name: Rainbow Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 36.8816,-81.8408: a cluster of RV pads in a wooded valley; the creek the tent sites sit on is not beside the RV pads - not waterfront

name: Riverside Camp and Marina
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 37.3952,-76.9332: a handful of RV pads on open ground 25-50 m back from the Chickahominy shoreline with the marina piers in front; the operator calls them 'waterview' sites. View, not a water's-edge row - riverview

name: South Forty Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 37.0772,-77.3520: loops of RV pads in pines SW of the road; no water - not waterfront (pin moved ~200 m SW from the entrance onto the loops)

name: Stokesville Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 1400 m frame) at 38.3522,-79.1512: the campground fields lie south of the North River crossing where the Google pin sat; pads not resolvable in the imagery, pin moved ~200 m SW into the fields; the river is not beside them - not waterfront
